title: Resolve USAID former-headquarters transition and post-transfer occupancy
summary: Recover authoritative property/lease/space records that establish when USAID ceased agency-wide headquarters occupancy at 1300 Pennsylvania Avenue NW and which successor State or oversight components remain there.

sources.title: Office of Inspector General Student Internship Program
Evaluation of Department of State Administration of Foreign Assistance Programs Transferred from the U.S. Agency for International Development
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State Office of Inspector General

data.target: USAID former headquarters transition and post-transfer occupancy
data.query: USAID 1300 Pennsylvania Avenue Ronald Reagan Building headquarters lease occupancy transfer State Department 2025 2026
data.research_question: What authoritative property or agency records establish the exact end of USAID agency-wide headquarters occupancy and the post-transfer use of 1300 Pennsylvania Avenue NW?
objectives: Recover GSA, USAID OIG, State, lease, or space-management evidence for the headquarters transition
Distinguish USAID OIG presence from former USAID agency-wide headquarters occupancy
Resolve exact temporal validity without inferring from organizational restructuring alone
selection_reason: Current public evidence supports the historic address but not an exact agency-wide move-out date
USAID OIG still identifies the Ronald Reagan Building as its headquarters
State assumed select USAID functions in July 2025, requiring careful temporal semantics
